notes: Shopify store, reached by DIRECT fetch (no proxy needed). Counts taken from the server-rendered listing header ('See N results' / 'N items') and independently verified by exhausting /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and counting unique product ids - the two methods agreed EXACTLY on all 27 collections tested, so the header is trustworthy here. Hierarchy further proved by sum checks on product-ID sets: Lighting 94 = Table & Floor Lamps 63 + Wall Lighting 18 + Ceiling Lights 13, and each of those equals the exact sum of its own children (54+5+4, 13+5, 2+6+5). Home Accents 154 is exactly the union of its ten children, and Entertaining 51 is exactly Serveware 35 + Dishware 17 minus 1 shared item - so all three are pure roll-ups and are emitted as parent rows only. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: Rugs, Pillows & Fabric, Bedding, Throw Blankets (9) and all textiles (the brand's core, out of scope); Wallpaper; all Furniture; Bath; Candles & Scents (16) - product titles are 5 reed diffusers plus scented candles ('Cedar Scented Taper Candles', 'Spearmint Scented', 'Tomato Scented'), i.e. home fragrance, with no unscented child to salvage; Faux Florals (7); Baskets (4, storage) and Tissue Holders (11, bath); Best Sellers / New / Sale / Dorm Collection / designer collaboration pages (marketing, not categories). 'Original Art' was checked and is an EMPTY collection (header 'See 0 results'), so it is omitted rather than recorded as a zero row. Cait Kids 'Decor' (30) and 'Lighting' (11) were tested by product ID and are re-cuts, not new inventory: 11 of 11 kids lighting items are already inside Lighting, and 24 of 30 kids decor items are already inside the Home Accents children (the 6 others are wastebaskets and a bulletin board, out of scope) - both dropped as subsets. Note /collections/table-lamps and /collections/desk-table-lamps are aliases (both 54); the mega-menu's own link, desk-table-lamps, is used. Minor impurity noted, not corrected: 'Accents' (25) contains 2 makeup bags among 23 decorative objects.
